We need parse user story format: As a role, I want something, so that something. Means is "I want..." ends is "so that...".

We need decide if means states a feature, not vague or ends feature. Ends introduces rationale not another feature. We should not penalize for syntactic errors unless relevant.

Means: view list of sponsors -> feature. Ends: thank sponsors -> rationale. No violation.

No violation? Need operational: ends explains why means is valuable. "It is easier to use" yes, though pronoun unclear. No violation.

This may be violation because ends introduces another required feature. Need decide. We assess only criterion. The story means is feature edit node; ends partly rationale, partly feature.
